fieldData.full-article-text: For developers, exchanges, and wallet creators, the JSON-RPC API offers a simple way of interacting with the Radix network by connecting to an archive node that offers the API endpoint. Radix provides archive nodes for public use – or often it is preferable for the client user to maintain one of their own. Please visit docs.radixdlt.com for more information about using the JSON-RPC API and setting up an archive node.
